versions.scplainer: workflow in scp 1.22.0; no separate package

cause: A comment appended to the qz assignment swallowed the mask assignment. Both half-preset workers errored before writing a preset; zero predictions and zero observations completed.
correction: Put the mask assignment on its own line. Register the corrected code before rerunning the same input data, split seeds, grid and injection/prediction seeds. No probability formula, noise model, endpoint or criterion changed.
